accessDenied.title: No staff access
accessDenied.reason: Only the owner or an admin can manage the team at {branch}.

title: Staff
summary: {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} at {branch}

empty.title: No staff yet
empty.description: Invite cashiers, kitchen staff and managers to share access to the dashboard, POS and KDS.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Everything you can do, except billing and adding another admin. For a business partner or general manager.

manager.label: Manager
manager.description: Runs the day to day: orders, refunds, menu, stock, promos, drivers, reports and staff hours. No billing, branding or staff invites.

cashier.label: Cashier
cashier.description: Counter and payments. Takes orders and money, applies discounts, reprints receipts, cancels before payment. Refunds need a manager.

server.label: Server
server.description: Dine-in only. Builds a table order, sends it to the kitchen and watches its progress. Sees only their own orders — no takings, no reports.

kitchen.label: Kitchen
kitchen.description: The kitchen display only. Accept, cooking, ready, plus marking items low or sold out. No customer or payment details.

driver.label: Driver
driver.description: Appears in your staff list but has no back-office access at all — riders work in the Driver app, where they see only their own jobs and earnings.

staff.label: Staff (general)
staff.description: Counter access only. The original catch-all role, kept for existing team members.

errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

branchAccess.label: Branch access
branchAccess.ownerLocked: The owner always has every branch.
branchAccess.adminLocked: Only the owner can change an admin’s branch access.

errors.notAuthorized: Your role cannot change this person’s branch access.
errors.invalidBranch: That branch is not part of this restaurant.
errors.notFound: This team member no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.generic: Branch access could not be changed. Try again.

invite.title: Invite staff member
invite.sentBody: We emailed {email} a link. Opening it adds them to the team and asks them to choose a password.
invite.addedBody: {email} already had an account, so no email was needed — they can sign in here right now with the password they already use.

errors.alreadyActive: {email} is already on your team. To change which branches they can use, set their Branch access in the staff list instead of inviting them again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many emails were sent in the last hour. The built-in email service allows only a few per hour — try again later, or connect your own email service in Supabase (Authentication → SMTP).
errors.onlyOwnerAdmin: Only the owner can invite or change an admin.
errors.notAllowed: Only the owner or an admin can invite staff.
errors.emailFailed: The invitation email could not be sent. Try again later.
errors.generic: The invitation could not be sent. Try again.
